name: e-Shram National Database & Accidental Insurance
organization: Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India
targetWorkerType: Unorganised Workers, Gig & Platform Delivery Partners, Drivers
description: Centralized registration portal for unorganised workers that issues a Universal Account Number (UAN) card and provides direct access to accidental death and disability benefits.
potentialBenefit: ₹2,00,000 cover in case of accidental death or permanent disability; ₹1,00,000 for partial disability. Direct portal integration for DBT during national emergencies.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Number with linked mobile phone
Active Savings Bank Account with IFSC code
applicationSteps: Visit the official e-Shram portal (eshram.gov.in).
Enter Aadhaar linked mobile number and complete OTP verification.
Fill personal, address, and primary occupation details.
Enter bank account details for Direct Benefit Transfer.
Download and print your 12-digit UAN card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
organization: Ministry of Labour & Employment & LIC of India
targetWorkerType: Street vendors, delivery workers, drivers, domestic workers, daily-wage laborers
description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers to ensure financial dignity in old age.
potentialBenefit: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining 60 years of age. 50% monthly contribution by subscriber matched by equal 50% co-contribution by the Central Government.
requiredDocuments: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with auto-debit facility
Initial contribution amount in cash (₹55 to ₹200 depending on entry age)
applicationSteps: Visit the nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) or maandhan.in portal.
Provide Aadhaar and bank details for biometric/OTP authentication.
Auto-debit mandate is set up for monthly bank account deduction.
Receive Shram Yogi Pension Card with unique SYM number.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
organization: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
targetWorkerType: Urban Street Vendors, Food Carts, Independent Informal Retailers
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital to street vendors to restart and expand livelihoods.
potentialBenefit: Initial collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), upgradable to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 upon timely repayment. 7% per annum interest subsidy credited directly to bank account, plus up to ₹1,200 annual cash-back on digital transactions.
requiredDocuments: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body (ULB) Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
applicationSteps: Check vending eligibility at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or contact Urban Local Body.
Submit digital loan application with preferred lending institution.
Complete e-KYC and digital mandate for subsidy crediting.
Loan disbursed directly to bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
organization: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
targetWorkerType: All individuals and workers with a bank account
description: Government-backed, low-cost term life insurance plan offering financial protection to informal workers' families.
potentialBenefit: ₹2,00,000 life insurance sum assured payable to nominee upon death of insured from any cause, for an annual premium of ₹436.
requiredDocuments: Nominee details and auto-debit consent form
applicationSteps: Log in to internet banking/mobile banking or visit your bank branch.
Submit the auto-debit consent form for PMJJBY enrollment.
Annual premium of ₹436 is auto-debited once per year between May 25 and May 31.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
organization: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
targetWorkerType: All workers with a savings bank account, delivery partners, drivers
description: Ultra-affordable micro-insurance for accidental death and permanent disability, tailored for high-mobility informal workers.
potentialBenefit: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or total permanent disability; ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability, for an annual premium of only ₹20.
requiredDocuments: Savings Bank Account with auto-debit mandate
applicationSteps: Activate via mobile banking app, SMS service, or visit your bank branch.
Provide consent for annual auto-debit of ₹20.
Receive insurance certificate with policy number from your bank.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Health Protection)
organization: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
targetWorkerType: Low-income gig workers, driver families, construction and informal laborers
description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing catastrophic medical expense coverage for vulnerable families.
potentialBenefit: Cashless hospitalization coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empaneled public and private hospitals for secondary and tertiary care.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card for each family member
applicationSteps: Verify family inclusion at mera.pmjay.gov.in or call toll-free 14555.
Visit any empaneled hospital or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Complete biometric verification with Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra (PMAM).
Receive Ayushman PVC Card with unique AB-PMJAY ID.

name: Building & Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Welfare Fund
organization: State BOCW Welfare Boards / Ministry of Labour & Employment
targetWorkerType: Construction laborers, electricians, plumbers, painters, masonry workers
description: Statutory welfare fund financed by construction cess providing comprehensive social security, tools assistance, and educational support.
potentialBenefit: Financial grants for safety equipment & toolkits (₹5,000–₹10,000), maternity assistance, accidental disability relief up to ₹4,00,000, and educational scholarships for children.
requiredDocuments: 90-day working certificate issued by employer, registered contractor, or trade union
applicationSteps: Apply online on your state's Labour Department BOCW portal or offline at district labour office.
Upload 90-day work certificate and identity proofs.
Pay annual nominal membership fee (₹20 to ₹50 depending on state).
Receive BOCW Smart Labour Card.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
targetWorkerType: Freelancers, self-employed, platform workers, shop assistants
description: Government-guaranteed pension scheme aimed primarily at workers in the unorganized sector to create an automatic retirement corpus.
potentialBenefit: Fixed guaranteed monthly pension between ₹1,000 and ₹5,000 starting at age 60. Same pension amount payable to spouse upon death, with full corpus return to nominee.
applicationSteps: Approach bank branch where savings account is maintained or use netbanking APY module.
Select desired pension tier (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and debit frequency (monthly, quarterly, half-yearly).
Receive Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) acknowledgment.
